defects: Bottom strip is gray mush: formant/harmonic bands and bell-vs-voice structure are invisible, violating the 'must READ as a spectrogram' mandate
Spectrogram contrast crushed by 0.55 multiplier + 99.7th-percentile ref + 0.85 gamma, so only a faint smear survives on white

edits.old:
ref = np.percentile(S, 99.7)
    v = np.clip(S / (ref + 1e-6), 0, 1) ** 0.85
    v = v * 0.55                        # restrained: light ink texture, never a heavy band
edits.new:
ref = np.percentile(S, 99.0)
    v = np.clip(S / (ref + 1e-6), 0, 1) ** 0.55
    v = np.clip(v * 1.15, 0, 1)         # readable formant/harmonic bands, not mush

rounds.rationale: Left wipes and right staged geometry (vermillion only on nodes) match spec well. But the bottom zone fails its hard requirement: with v*0.55, gamma 0.85 and a 99.7% ref dominated by the bell transient, voiced bands map near-white and the strip reads as noise, not a spectrogram. Raising contrast (lower ref percentile, lower gamma, clipped boost) makes formants/harmonics legible while staying in ink-on-paper palette.
